# National identity number detection

<!-- Generated by node ci/rule-packs/build-detection.mjs --write. -->

Finds eleven-digit values within 128 scalar values of national-identity labels or common delimited NIN label spellings. Reports the value location at error severity.

Version: `2026.11.0`. Source: `rule-packs/nin.pack.json`.

The citation register records owner approval in principle; legal review remains pending. A finding requests review and does not establish a legal breach.

| Rule | Severity | Citation |
|---|---|---|
| `pii.nin` | error | Review protection of national identity identifiers. Sections 24(1)(c), 24(1)(f), 39 and 65; Article 29(1)-(2). |

## Limits

Literal prefilters fold ASCII case and do not parse code. Delimiters after the short NIN spelling avoid the incidental substring in words such as scanning; supported forms include assignment, JSON keys, prose and colon-delimited labels. No public check digit or issued-identity validation is assumed. Existing digit, date, version, UUID and documented-example exclusions apply. Unlabelled identifiers and unsafe field handling are separate rules.

## Remediation and exceptions

Remove unnecessary identity values from source, configuration and fixtures. Mask them before logging and minimise authorised responses. Use a justified exception only where retention is necessary.

## Verification

Run `dotnet test tests/Corpus.Tests -c Release --filter FullyQualifiedName~DetectionPackTests` for exact locations and measured synthetic precision/recall.

These are unsigned release-source packs. Tests sign only in memory with the labelled development key. Production signing, embedding and publication are separate release operations; no development signature is shipped.
